plan.scope: Frozen m2 signed SET4-terminal -> RESET4 -> SET5; RESET4-only b calibration
plan.SET5_incoming_u: Each precision's actual RESET4 terminal_u; no measured anchor or reset
plan.RHS_check: Independent unified q equation versus signed u RHS on selected already-solved 12 points
plan.objective: Mean squared log10(|I_model|/|I_observed|) on all170 original RESET4 eligible points only
plan.invalid_objective: positive infinity for optimizer, JSON null with explicit failure status; no finite penalty/clipping
plan.timing: Accumulate active static/RHS/phase/diagnostic/legacy numerical call wall time only. Input loading, byte serialization, hashing and disk I/O separately recorded; no active timer during I/O.
plan.timeout_policy: Any search phase timeout stops the entire search; a complete prior best may enter reserved final verification; no retries
plan.feature_scope: 13 single-record references, never original20 aggregate validation
plan.output_hash_policy: SHA256 of exactly serialized bytes recorded on every write; no repeated output reads required
